title: Theoretical determination of electronic properties of resorcinol and hydroquinone as building blocks of molecular wires
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44194-44204
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06041A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jhon S. Martínez, Daniel Gallego, Judith H. Ojeda S.
The energy coupling and disubstitution pattern in the aromatic ring play a crucial role in the conductivity. Resorcinol presents quantum interference and discrete energy channels, whereas hydroquinone showcases a more stable electronic transport.
